name: Tooltip
description: A tooltip: a short text in a small dark or light box with an arrow, shown next to an element on hover and keyboard focus or on click. It describes the element (aria-describedby) or, for icon-only controls, names it (aria-labelledby). Opens in the top layer, flips when there is no room, hides with Escape and stays open while hovered.
useWhen: Naming an icon-only button or link for sighted users (mode="label")
Adding a short hint to a control, such as a keyboard shortcut or what a disabled-looking state means
Confirming a quick action in place, such as "Copied!" after copying
avoidWhen: Content with links, buttons or other controls: use Popover
Information people need to complete a task: put it on the page or in HelperText
Touch-first interfaces, where hover doesn't exist: show the text instead
Long or rich content: use Popover
